_comment: Theseus rebase across model *widths*: t5-v1_1-small (d_model 512, 8+8 blocks) -> t5-v1_1-base (d_model 768, 12+12 blocks). This is the interesting cross-architecture case; shapes differ, so the 'untransported' baseline is automatically disabled and the reported baseline becomes target_zeroshot (B with its own head), exactly as vision_rebase does for a cross-arch pair.
_depth_note: 8 -> 12 blocks means only name-matching blocks are transported; there is no text equivalent of the ViT-only block-extension preprocess. text_rebase.py prints the depth and the delta key coverage at startup.
_seq_align: interpolate (linear over the token axis). The vision default interpolate2d assumes a square patch grid and is wrong for text; text_rebase.py sets this default itself if omitted.
